texts.en:
Even as overall progress stalled, our [owner.GetResearchers] revealed the entrance to a previously undiscovered chamber. Inside was a massive statue, as imposing as it is beautiful.

Avian in form, its long, powerful neck is fashioned of metallic links that somehow manage to hover in place. Sharp plumage erupts from a patrician skull, and its eyes are golden heralds of power. Moving through the chamber, our [owner.GetResearchers] had the uncomfortable sensation that they were being watched.

Behind the figure they discovered hidden a door or seal, but whatever this baleful bird was guarding has long since ceased to function.
